about.title: About Sankalp Foundation
about.story: Sankalp Foundation was established with a simple but powerful belief: that every person, regardless of where they are born, deserves access to education, health, and livelihood. We work at the grassroots level, with communities rather than for them.
about.mission: To empower underserved communities through sustainable programs in education, health, and livelihood — building a future of dignity and opportunity for all.
about.vision: A society where every individual has equal access to opportunity and can live with dignity, health, and hope.
